default: # Next Steps Suggester for Google Antigravity > **Proactive, 1-click prompt chips at the end of every turn. Turn completed tasks into immediate momentum.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps) [![Live Simulator](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live%20Simulator-domush.github.io-6366f1?style=flat&logo=github)](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Antigravity App Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity%20App-Native%20Plugin-818cf8.svg)]() **Next Steps Suggester** stops "blank canvas fatigue" in the **Google Antigravity App**. Whenever your agent finishes a task, it presents at least two relevant, clickable follow-up options directly in chat using Antigravity's native prompt chips. Instead of stopping and typing out a whole new prompt, you click an option and the agent immediately gets to work. > 🌐 **Try the Live Interactive Simulator:** [domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps](https://domush.github.io/antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps/) --- ## Quick Install (10 Seconds) Install directly into Google Antigravity using `npx`: ```bash # Global install (available across all Antigravity chats) npx antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps install # Or per-project install (scoped to current workspace only) npx antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps install --workspace ``` Restart or open the **Google Antigravity App**, and the plugin is active immediately. --- ## How It Works ```text ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 1. Agent completes your request in full │ │ "Authentication middleware created and verified." │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 2. Agent explains candidate follow-ups in chat text │ │ • (Recommended) Refresh Token Rotation in Redis │ │ • Add OAuth2 Google / GitHub Providers │ │ • Generate OpenAPI / Swagger documentation │ └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 3. Native 1-Click Interactive Prompt Card │ │ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Suggested next steps: │ │ │ │ [✓] (Recommended) Add refresh token rotation │ │ │ │ [ ] Add OAuth2 Google / GitHub Providers │ │ │ │ [ ] Generate OpenAPI / Swagger documentation │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ [Skip / Conclude Turn] [Confirm Selection] │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` You click an option, and the agent immediately continues with that task. If you're done, simply click **Skip** and the agent concludes cleanly. --- ## Why You'll Love It * ⚡ **Zero Friction**: Eliminate the pause where you have to think about what to prompt next. * 🎯 **Smart Prioritization**: The single highest-leverage continuation (like running tests, updating docs, or staging a deployment) is tagged with `(Recommended)`. * ☑️ **Multi-Select Batching**: When multiple tasks can be handled together (e.g. write docs + commit + tag release), select all that apply. * 🛡️ **No Subagent Spam**: Strictly isolated to the main chat assistant. Background workers and subagents are barred from prompting you directly. * 🚪 **Respectful Skip**: If you skip or dismiss the prompt, the agent wraps up immediately with zero nagging. * 🔒 **100% Local & Private**: No analytics, no background telemetry, and zero runtime dependencies. --- ## Managing the Plugin ### Enable / Disable Anytime Open the **Google Antigravity App** → open **Customizations** → **Plugins**, and toggle **Next Steps Suggester** on or off with one click. ### Uninstall To remove the plugin from your system: ```bash # Remove global plugin npx antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps uninstall # Remove per-project plugin npx antigravity-plugin-suggest-next-steps uninstall --workspace ``` --- ## License MIT © [Phillip Webber](https://github.com/Domush)
